## ⚛️ Template Structure Applied

### Core Sections (6)
1. **🎯 Mission Overview** - Purpose, energy level, operational status
2. **⚖️ Verification Checklist** - Prerequisites, validation criteria
3. **📈 Success Metrics** - KPI tracking with targets and status
4. **⚛️ Physics Alignment** - Path/Fields/Patterns/Redundancy/Balance
5. **⚡ Energy Distribution** - Priority breakdown (P0-P2)
6. **🧠 Redundancy Patterns** - Fallback strategies, error recovery

### Agent-Specific Extensions (8)

8. **🛠️ Capabilities Matrix** - Tools, permissions, scope
9. **💡 Usage Examples** - Invocation patterns, examples
10. **🔗 Integration Patterns** - Workflow integration, dependencies
11. **⚡ Activation Commands** - Manual, GitHub Actions, programmatic
12. **📦 Tool Dependencies** - Required/optional tools, versions
13. **📤 Output Formats** - JSON, Markdown, logs
14. **⚠️ Error Handling** - Failure modes, recovery procedures
